positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed automation tools for clients handling big data collection, management, and analysis.
•	Handled big data consisting of XML data.
•	Developed automation tools using C# and ASP.NET.

•	Improved automation tools’ software durability, maintainability, reusability, and scalability.
•	Improved performance of automation tools decreasing testing time from two days to two hours.

positions.title: Intern

•	Verified and manipulated data using Oracle SQL Developer.
•	Performed regression testing on iOS devices.
